install_steps: Or: curl -sSLo terraform-docs.tar.gz https://terraform-docs.io/dl/v0.19.0/terraform-docs-v0.19.0-$(uname)-$(uname -m).tar.gz && tar -xzf terraform-docs.tar.gz && sudo mv terraform-docs /usr/local/bin/
note: Available via Homebrew, asciinema, or direct binary download. Supports Markdown, JSON, YAML, and TOML output formats.
